item.title: Ocala doctor gets probation, fine over prescriptions that caused patient’s heart attack
item.description: An Ocala physician has been fined $7,500 and placed on probation by state health officials following a medical malpractice complaint that he prescribed unnecessary thyroid medication to a patient who then suffered a heart attack as a result. Read more: Ocala doctor gets probation, fine over prescriptions that caused patient’s heart attack

item.title: I have no kids, no fire hydrants, no trash service, and dirt roads. My taxes went up for things I can’t access.
item.description: "I feel Tom O’Connor's pain. I live in West Ocala, towards Dunnellon. We have to pay for our own garbage or haul it to the dump. We have never had any kids in any school. There's not a fire hydrant within 10 miles of our house. The roads are dirt. No street lights on any roads. But the taxes go up for things we have no access to." - An Ocala resident shares his opinion. Read more: I have no kids, no fire hydrants, no trash service, and dirt roads. My taxes went up for things I can’t access.

item.title: Scammers suing Ocala businesses over bogus slip-and-fall claims should be punished
item.description: "We are not the car wash city anymore, we've become the slip & fall/sue you city. Publix has been a main target, but there's been others too, all pretty recently. If you watch local network television, it's mostly lawyer ads. These "accidents" must be on security tape and should be examined carefully to show who is the real victim. Scammers should be punished! Cars are not the only thing in Ocala that need cleaning up." - A Marion County resident shares her opinion. Read more: Scammers suing Oca
